RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
Freeze gates are rendered as narrow vertical DOUBLE LINES with dashed grey border and a small grey [Fixed] pill; NO padlock symbol.
The conditional external-validation block uses a DOTTED border to distinguish it from solid required modules.
Amber (#E69F00) appears only on the pilot badge border; never as text colour.
Feedback loop arrow is DASHED and curves along the bottom edge; main forward flow arrows are SOLID.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 8-9pt, notes 7-8pt.
Icons are monochrome thin grey line art. No colored icons.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning decorative symbols, NO 3D rendering.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no drop shadows.
